Barclays India Hackathon, 2019 
Nidhee Kamble 
Finalist, Team ​Smurfs​, VJTI 
 
 
 
Team: Ameya Daddikar, Nidhee Kamble, Yash Gupte 
 
Selection through: Hackathon rounds 
Format: 
Round 1:​ ​Team coding​ round, 3 questions; 
Round 2:​ ​Individual coding​ round, ~9 questions; 
Round 3:​ 15-hour hackathon, venue: Sheraton Grand, Pune 
a) Technical  
b) H.R. 
 
Note: The teams were selected for Round 3 of the Hackathon based on the results on Round 1 and 
Round 2 aggregated. However, the Technical and H.R. rounds were conducted parallely with the 
hackathon. The interviews and its results were independent of the proceedings of the hackathon 
finale and were based on the aforementioned rounds. 
 
 
ROUND 1 
1st June, 2019 
# Questions: 3 
Duration: 03 hours 
 
Q1: Question similar to ​N-queen problem​, but modified. (Dynamic programming) 
Q2: ​Bit manipulation​. 
Q3: Logic based, but had a formula that needed to be derived. 
 
 
ROUND 2 
5th-6th-7th June, 2019 
Duration per day: 02 hours 
# Questions: 3 or 4 per day. 
 
Question domains​: 
Segment trees 
Divide and Conquer 
Dynamic Programming 
Variations/applications of Kadane’s algorithm 
Graphs 
 
 
ROUND 3(a) 
27th June, 2019

Question basis: Broadly, ​resume-based​. 
Project:​ frameworks, architecture 
Languages:​ Library implementation specific 
Other ​courses/domains​ that have been done and/or mentioned 
Domains​ for other questions: 
Database management:​ some theoretical questions, database-specific syntaxes  
Object-Oriented Programming:​ concepts and implementation, Java 
System Design:​ Development styles, scaling and sharding, Redis, UML
